pick.headline: Car bomb at US military training mission in Riyadh
pick.summary: On November 13, 1995, a car bomb exploded outside a US-run training office for the Saudi National Guard in Riyadh, killing five Americans and two Indians.
pick.significance: It was the first major attack on the US military presence in Saudi Arabia, a precursor of the Khobar Towers bombing in 1996.
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia report of November 13, 1995, carried AFP's same-day dispatch that an explosion had ripped through the building housing the Saudi American National Guard development mission, causing American casualties.

alternates.headline: Nevado del Ruiz eruption buries Armero
alternates.summary: On November 13, 1985, the Nevado del Ruiz volcano in Colombia erupted, and mudflows buried the town of Armero, killing over twenty thousand people.
alternates.significance: It was one of the deadliest volcanic disasters of the century, coming a week after the Palace of Justice siege.
alternates.fbis: AFP's Spanish service reported on November 14 that the town of Armero had disappeared under a layer of mud after the volcano erupted, according to the police.
